Infrastructure.fact: The President of India, Smt. Infrastructure.subject: PIB Releases
Infrastructure.question: True or False: Department of Consumer Affairs NOT launches nationwide training programme on Legal Metrology reforms.
Infrastructure.fact: The Department of Consumer Affairs has launched a nationwide capacity-building initiative for Legal Metrology Officers across the country following the decriminalisation of provisions of the Legal Metrology Act, 2009 and the introduction of wide-ranging reforms under the Act and Rules, including the Jan Vishwas reforms and measures to promote ease of doing business. The specialised training programme is designed particularly for frontline Legal Metrology Officers of the States and Union Territories, who directly enforce the provisions of the Act and Rules.

Infrastructure.subject: PIB Releases
Infrastructure.question: OFFICER TRAINEES OF INDIAN FOREIGN SERVICE CALL ON THE PRESIDENT.
Infrastructure.fact: The Officer Trainees of Indian Foreign Service (2025 Batch) and two diplomats from Bhutan who are currently undergoing induction training programme in Sushma Swaraj Institute of Foreign Service called on the President of India, Smt Droupadi Murmu at Rashtrapati Bhavan today (August 27, 2026). Speaking on the occasion, the President congratulated the Officer Trainees of the Indian Foreign Service and said that they will have the privilege and responsibility of representing India abroad, advancing the nation's interests, and strengthening India's relations with countries across the world.

Infrastructure.subject: PIB Releases
Infrastructure.question: Legal Metrology (Indian Standard Time) Rules, _____ Notified: Major Step Towards “One Nation, One Time”
Infrastructure.fact: The Government of India has notified the Legal Metrology (Indian Standard Time) Rules, 2026, marking a significant step towards establishing Indian Standard Time (IST) as the common, legally recognised and traceable time reference for the country. The Rules, notified by the Department of Consumer Affairs, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution, on 27 August 2026 and published in the Official Gazette on 29 August 2026, provide a comprehensive framework for the generation, maintenance, dissemination and use of IST.

Infrastructure.subject: PIB Releases
Infrastructure.question: Department of Posts, Delhi Circle to Hold Monthly Dak Adalat on September _____ 2026
Infrastructure.fact: The Department of Posts, Delhi Circle will hold a Monthly Dak Adalat for the settlement of grievances related to Postal Services under the National Capital Territory of Delhi/Delhi State. The Dak Adalat will be held on September 18, 2026 (Friday), at 1100 hours at the O/o the Chief Postmaster General, Delhi Circle, 3rd Floor, Meghdoot Bhawan, near Jhandewalan Metro Station, New Delhi-110001. The Dak Adalat will provide an opportunity to hear each complainant individually and settle the grievances/problems of the public.

Infrastructure.subject: PIB Releases
Infrastructure.question: True or False: Indore Metro Priority Corridor–2 postponed.
Infrastructure.fact: Union Minister for Housing and Urban Affairs Shri Manohar Lal, in the presence of Chief Minister of Madhya Pradesh Shri Mohan Yadav, today inaugurated the Indore Metro Priority Corridor-2, marking a significant milestone in the city's urban mobility journey. Minister of State for Housing and Urban Affairs Shri Tokhan Sahu was also present on the occasion. The newly inaugurated phase-I (Reach-II) of approx 11 km comprising 11-stations starting from Super Corridor-3 to Malviya Nagar Chauraha and has been developed at an estimated cost of ₹2,850 crore.

Infrastructure.subject: PIB Releases
Infrastructure.question: Department of Consumer Affairs Notifies Legal Metrology (Indian Standard Time) Rules, _____
Infrastructure.fact: The Department of Consumer Affairs has notified the Legal Metrology (Indian Standard Time) Rules, 2026 on 27 August 2026 . The Rules will come into force 180 days from the date of their publication in the Official Gazette . The Rules provide for Indian Standard Time (IST) as the common time reference across the country for legal, administrative, commercial and other official purposes. The 180-day period will allow Government departments, businesses, institutions and other organisations to make the required changes to their systems before the Rules come into force.

Infrastructure.subject: PIB Releases
Infrastructure.question: Dr. Jitendra Singh Calls for Wider Awareness about Rs 2 Crore RDI Fund Among Stakeholders to Ensure Right Beneficiaries Avail of Support.
Infrastructure.fact: Union Minister for Science & Technology Dr. Jitendra Singh today called for greater awareness and outreach about Rs 1 Lakh Crore "Research, Development and Innovation Fund" (RDI Fund) among stakeholders so that the right kind of applicants understand its purpose, eligibility and the process for availing support. Addressing the 30th Foundation Day of the Technology Development Board (TDB), Dr. Jitendra Singh said that the focus should be on creating awareness about the spirit behind the RDI Fund, the stakeholders and companies eligible for support, and how they can avail of the funding.

Infrastructure.question: LOK SABHA SPEAKER REAFFIRMS INDIA'S SUPPORT FOR PEACE, STABILITY AND NATIONAL RECONCILIATION IN MYANMAR.
Infrastructure.fact: Lok Sabha Speaker Shri Om Birla, today, stressed that India, as a close and friendly neighbour with deep people-to-people ties with Myanmar, sincerely desires peace and stability in Myanmar. Shri Birla also welcomed the progress being made by Myanmar towards peace and national reconciliation and conveyed India's readiness to remain a strong and dependable partner in this journey. He made these remarks while welcoming a parliamentary delegation from Myanmar led by Dr. Pwint San, Chairperson, International Relations Committee, Parliament of Myanmar.

Infrastructure.subject: PIB Releases
Infrastructure.question: Union Minister of Civil Aviation Reviews Measures to Simplify and Automate NOC Process; Directs Time-Bound Action Wit...
Infrastructure.fact: Union Minister of Civil Aviation Shri Kinjarapu Rammohan Naidu held a meeting with senior officers of the Ministry of Civil Aviation and the Airports Authority of India (AAI) to review measures for promoting Ease of Doing Business in the civil aviation sector, with particular emphasis on simplifying and streamlining the process for issuance of No Objection Certificates (NOCs). During the meeting, Shri Rammohan Naidu emphasized the need to make the NOC process hassle-free, transparent, automated and time-bound, with minimal manual intervention.

Infrastructure.subject: PIB Releases
Infrastructure.question: _____ Kilometres, Countless Beneficiaries: Mizoram’s Railway Lifeline Completes One Year of Success
Infrastructure.fact: On 13 th September 2025, the inauguration of the 51.38 km Bairabi-Sairang railway line and the Sairang Railway station by Hon'ble Prime Minister of India, Shri Narendra Modi, opened a new chapter of progress and development for Mizoram. Within just one year, the railway line has brought about transformative development in this remote hill state, and has transformed from just a line on the railway map into a gateway towards improved mobility, greater access to markets, enhanced tourism and new opportunities.

Infrastructure.subject: PIB Releases
Infrastructure.question: True or False: Two-Day National Symposium on Geosynthetics for Highways and Railways Inaugurated at CSIR-CRRI, New Delhi.
Infrastructure.fact: The two-day National Symposium on "Geosynthetics for Performance Enhancement and Distress Mitigation in Highways and Railways" officially commenced today at the CSIR-Central Road Research Institute (CSIR-CRRI) Auditorium in New Delhi. Jointly organized by CSIR-CRRI and the Geosynthetics Society (GS), Pune, the symposium convenes leading policymakers, infrastructure authorities, geotechnical specialists, and industry experts to address critical engineering solutions for national highway networks, high-speed rail lines, and strategic mountain corridors.

Infrastructure.question: True or False: MoS for Railways Shri V. Somanna Reviews Safety, Operations, Punctuality and Public Grievances at Delhi Division Control Office.
Infrastructure.fact: Minister of State for Railways & Jal Shakti Shri V. Somanna today visited the Control Office of Delhi Division and reviewed various aspects of railway operations, including safety, train operations, punctuality and public grievances. During the visit, the Minister interacted with officials and staff of the Control Office. He also held detailed discussions with DRM Delhi Shri Pushpesh R. Tripathi and his team. Infrastructure.question: Indian Railways Approves ₹_____ Crore for Upgradation of Electric Traction System to 2x25 kV on 73 RKM Savalyapuram
Infrastructure.fact: Indian Railways has approved the upgradation of the electric traction system from 1x25 kV to 2x25 kV on the 73 Route Kilometre Savalyapuram-Guntur section of South Coast Railway at a total cost of ₹142 crore. Covering 146 Track Kilometres, the project will strengthen the electric traction infrastructure and enhance its capacity to support growing railway operations. The upgradation of the electric traction system on the Savalyapuram-Guntur section forms part of HUN Route 8, covering the Vasco-Gadag-Guntakal-Nandyal-Savalyapuram-Guntur-Vijayawada route.

Infrastructure.fact: The wage ceiling for mandatory coverage under the E mployees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) has been enhanced from Rs. 15,000 to Rs. 25,000 per month with effect from Vishwakarma Jayanti and Sewa Divas on 17 September 2026. This was announced by Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya, Union Minister of Labour & Employment and Youth Affairs & Sports in a press briefing today. This decision, approved by the Union Cabinet earlier today, is expected to bring a large number of additional employees within the ambit of mandatory EPFO coverage, thereby widening access to statutory social security protection.

Reportedly, they were accusing her of leaving home with another man. The Commission has observed that the contents of the media report, if true, raise serious issues of violation of the victim's rights to life and dignity.

Announcements.fact: The Union Cabinet chaired by the Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi has approved payment of PLB of 78 days for Rs.2009.61 crore to 11,40,770 railway employees, in recognition of the excellent performance by the Railway staff. Payment of PLB to eligible railway employees is made each year before the Durga Puja/Dusshera holidays. This year also, PLB amount equivalent to 78 days' wages is being paid to about 11.40 lakh non-gazetted Railway employees. The payment of PLB acts as an incentive to motivate the railway employees for working towards improvement in the performance of the Railways.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "Government Approves Strategic Restructuring of IDBI Bank Ltd."
Announcements.answer: Government Approves Strategic Restructuring of IDBI Bank Ltd.
Announcements.fact: IDBI Bank Ltd. is a scheduled commercial bank regulated by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). Due to its poor financial health, the Bank required repeated infusion of capital, initially provided by the Government of India and later by the LIC. On 5th May, 2017, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) put the IDBI Bank under the Prompt Corrective Action Framework and imposed several restrictions in view of its non-performing assets and losses incurred by the Bank.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) on Strategic Restructuring of IDBI Bank Ltd."
Announcements.answer: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) on Strategic Restructuring of IDBI Bank Ltd.
Announcements.fact: Q1. Who is the Strategic Buyer for the IDBI Bank Ltd.? Answer: M/s 10955230 Canada Inc. (parent entity M/s Fairfax Financial Holdings Ltd.) has been approved as the Strategic Buyer for the IDBI Bank Ltd. Q2. What is the size of this Transaction? Answer: The purchase consideration for this transaction is Rs.52,878.0806181 Crores (in words Rupees Fifty-Two Thousand Eight Hundred Seventy-Eight Crore Eight Lakh Six Thousand and One Hundred Eighty-One only). Q3. How will it be split between the Government of India (GoI) and the Life Insurance corporation of India (LIC)?

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "KAUMARACON 2026 to Begin at AIIA, New Delhi, on October 15; Vice"
Announcements.answer: KAUMARACON 2026 to Begin at AIIA, New Delhi, on October 15; Vice
Announcements.fact: The All India Institute of Ayurveda (AIIA), New Delhi, an autonomous organisation under the Ministry of Ayush, Government of India, will organise KAUMARACON 2026, the International Conference on Kaumarabhritya (Ayurveda Paediatrics), from October 15 to 17, 2026, at its Sarita Vihar campus in New Delhi. The three-day conference will bring together experts, academicians, researchers, practitioners and students from India and abroad to deliberate on advancements in Ayurveda-based child healthcare, research and clinical practice.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "MCL commits ₹22.64 Crore for Five CSR projects in Sundargarh District"
Announcements.answer: MCL commits ₹22.64 Crore for Five CSR projects in Sundargarh District
Announcements.fact: Mahanadi Coalfields Limited (MCL), under its CSR initiative has signed MoUs with the District Administration of Sundargarh on tuesday for five developmental projects worth ₹22.64 crore. The projects include the rejuvenation and beautification of Kata Bandha (₹4.32 crore), Brahamani Bandha (₹3.98 crore) and Abdul Hussain Bandha (₹2.69 crore); freshwater inland aquaculture in mining-affected areas of Hemgir Block (₹3.81 crore); and renovation, improvement and construction of tanks under Talsara Assembly Constituency (₹7.84 crore) in Sundargarh district.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "The Flight of Courage, the Identity of Self"
Announcements.answer: The Flight of Courage, the Identity of Self
Announcements.fact: Access to timely financial assistance and opportunities for entrepreneurship can help women overcome economic challenges and build independent livelihoods. Smt Sunithamol P.S.'s journey from a decade of unemployment to running a successful bakery reflects the transformative potential of livelihood support. Smt Sunithamol P.S., a resident of Mararikulam in Alappuzha district, Kerala, had completed her education up to the 12th standard. While raising her two children and managing household responsibilities, she remained unemployed for nearly ten years.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "From Recovery to Self-Reliance"
Announcements.answer: From Recovery to Self-Reliance
Announcements.fact: Access to timely counselling, rehabilitation and psychological support can help individuals overcome substance-related challenges and rebuild their lives. The journey of Ranjit Das (name changed), a 31-year-old resident of Nagaon district, Assam, reflects the importance of comprehensive de-addiction services in promoting recovery, restoring confidence and enabling individuals to move towards self-reliance and a dignified life. Ranjit Das, belonging to the Scheduled Caste community, had studied up to the high school level and faced several socio-economic challenges.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "Release of 121st Issue of Sarvekshana, Journal of Official Statistics"
Announcements.answer: Release of 121st Issue of Sarvekshana, Journal of Official Statistics
Announcements.fact: The 121st Issue of Sarvekshana , the premier bi-annual Journal of Official Statistics was released by National Statistical Systems Training Academy (NSSTA), Ministry of Statistics & Programme Implementation (MoSPI). Sarvekshana serves as a prominent platform for disseminating research based on data from National Sample Survey (NSS) and other Official Statistics. Recognised for its academic rigour and policy relevance, the journal contributes to the advancement of statistical research and promotes the wider use of official statistical data.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "10th National Convention of Agrivision–2026 held in New Delhi"
Announcements.answer: 10th National Convention of Agrivision–2026 held in New Delhi
Announcements.fact: The 10 th National Convention of Agrivision-2026 is being held on October 13 th -14 th at the ICAR-NASC Complex, Pusa, New Delhi, under the aegis of Agrivision, the ICAR Agricultural Education Division. As the 10 th national convention of Agrivision, the event marks a significant milestone and has brought together a broad cross-section of the agricultural community.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "MCL strengthens E-Waste Management Across Its Establishments under Special Campaign 6"
Announcements.answer: MCL strengthens E-Waste Management Across Its Establishments under Special Campaign 6
Announcements.fact: Mahanadi Coalfields Limited (MCL) has joined the nation in observing Special campaign 6 and is undertaking significant initiatives to promote responsible e-waste management across its Headquarters and operational areas. Special campaign 6 will be observed till 31 st October 2026 focusing on systematic waste collection, environmental awareness and promotion of cleanliness across all MCL establishments.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "Ministry of Mines Organises Outreach Programme on Auction of Offshore Mineral Blocks"
Announcements.answer: Ministry of Mines Organises Outreach Programme on Auction of Offshore Mineral Blocks
Announcements.fact: The Ministry of Mines, Government of India, organised an Outreach Programme on Auction of Offshore Mineral Blocks on 13th October 2026 at New Delhi. The programme provided a platform for prospective bidders and stakeholders to understand the two offshore mineral blocks offered for auction, the applicable policy and regulatory framework, the bidding process and the support available for exploration.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "Indian Railways Registers 6.14% Growth in Freight Loading in September 2026 over September 2025"
Announcements.answer: Indian Railways Registers 6.14% Growth in Freight Loading in September 2026 over September 2025
Announcements.fact: Indian Railways recorded continued growth in freight and passenger segments during September 2026, with higher freight loading, and growth across several key commodity categories. Freight loading during the first six months of the financial year also registered sustained growth, reflecting continued demand for rail transportation across major sectors of the economy.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "From Financial Hardship to Research Aspirations"
Announcements.answer: From Financial Hardship to Research Aspirations
Announcements.fact: Education can open pathways to advanced learning, research and professional growth, for students from economically disadvantaged backgrounds. When the Government support is made available, the financial constraints disappear that help the aspirants to continue higher education. Bhavesh A. Prabhakar, a resident of Ahmedabad, Gujarat, faced this challenge while aspiring to pursue a Ph.D. Coming from a family with limited financial resources, Bhavesh experienced significant economic barriers that threatened his ability to undertake doctoral studies.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "From Limited Income to a More Secure Livelihood"
Announcements.answer: From Limited Income to a More Secure Livelihood
Announcements.fact: Through targeted financial assistance and support for sanitation-related equipment, the Swachhta Udyami Yojana (SUY) under the NAMASTE framework is aimed to create opportunities for income generation and self-reliance. This way the sustainable livelihood opportunities can play an important role in improving the economic security and dignity of Safai Karamcharis. Shri Tadikonda Rambabu, aged 40, is a Safai Karamchari belonging to the Scheduled Caste community. He has been working with the Vijayawada Municipal Corporation on an outsourcing basis since 2016.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "From Addiction to Self-Reliance: A Journey of Recovery and Renewed Hope"
Announcements.answer: From Addiction to Self-Reliance: A Journey of Recovery and Renewed Hope
Announcements.fact: Through the National Action Plan for Drug Demand Reduction (NAPDDR), the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment provides support to individuals affected by substance use through treatment, counselling, rehabilitation and social reintegration services. Access to de-addiction treatment, rehabilitation and sustained psychological support can play an important role in helping individuals overcome substance dependence and rebuild their lives. Amit Kumar (name changed), aged 47, belongs to the Other Backward Classes (OBC) community and resides in Gorakhpur district of Uttar Pradesh.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "Khadi & Village Industries: From Tradition to Enterprise"
Announcements.answer: Khadi & Village Industries: From Tradition to Enterprise
Announcements.fact: A charkha spinning in a village once spoke of nationalism. Today, that spirit is taking new shape through a growing ecosystem of rural enterprises. Honey, herbal products, banana fibre, textiles and other village industries are creating new possibilities for traditional skills. The spirit of self-reliance continues to resonate with the vision of Vocal for Local and Atmanirbhar Bharat. Traditional skills and local resources are finding new markets through access to finance, technology and training.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "EXERCISE TARANG SHAKTI 2026: POWER IN PARTNERSHIP, STRENGTH IN SELF"
Announcements.answer: EXERCISE TARANG SHAKTI 2026: POWER IN PARTNERSHIP, STRENGTH IN SELF
Announcements.fact: The second edition of Exercise Tarang Shakti, hosted by the Indian Air Force at Air Force Station Jodhpur from 26 September to 12 October 2026, marks a significant milestone in India's growing engagement with partner air forces and its emergence as a key contributor to regional and global security. With the theme 'Power in Partnership', the multinational air exercise brings together seven Friendly Foreign Countries (FFCs)-Australia, Bangladesh, France, Germany, Sri Lanka, the United Arab Emirates and the United States of America-along with 32 observer nations.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "Citizen Centric Pan-India Rail Jan Samvaad to Be Held at All Stations on 22.10.2026"
Announcements.answer: Citizen Centric Pan-India Rail Jan Samvaad to Be Held at All Stations on 22.10.2026
Announcements.fact: A high-level review meeting was held through video conferencing on 08.10.2026 at Railway Board under the chairmanship of Secretary, Railway Board to reinforce and review the progress of Special Campaign for Disposal of Pending Matters 6 (SCDPM-6) on the Zonal Railways/Units. AGMs of Zonal Railways, DRMs and ADRMs of Divisions, CPROs of Zonal Railways, GMs of Production Units, CMDs/MDs of Railway PSUs, DGs of Training Institutes, Concerned officers of Railway Board and Nodal Officers of SCDPM 6 in field units participated in the meeting.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "Over 6 Lakh Rural Youth to be trained this year"
Announcements.answer: Over 6 Lakh Rural Youth to be trained this year
Announcements.fact: In a significant step towards strengthening rural entrepreneurship and promoting sustainable livelihood opportunities, the Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD) today exchanged a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the National Academy of RUDSETI (NAR) to establish uniform training standards, ensure quality administration and facilitate systematic capacity building across Rural Self Employment Training Institutes (RSETIs) in the country.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "Large- and small-scale magnetic activity driving microwave polar brightening in the Sun"
Announcements.answer: Large- and small-scale magnetic activity driving microwave polar brightening in the Sun
Announcements.fact: Researchers have probed the mystery of why the poles of the Sun shine much brighter than the rest of the solar disk when mapped at certain specific microwave and radio frequencies. The study could provide valuable insights into the magnetic field and temperature conditions in the Sun's polar atmosphere. The Sun's polar regions play an important role in the evolution of its magnetic field and the generation of the solar wind. However, despite decades of observations, the cause of microwave polar brightening, the enhanced radio emission seen near the Sun's poles, has remained unclear.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What was approved recently by the Government of India?
Announcements.answer: for Upgradation of Nine Government ITIs
Announcements.fact: In a major boost to India's ITIs ecosystem, Shareholders' Agreements (SHAs) have been signed under the Pradhan Mantri Skilling and Employability Transformation through Upgraded ITIs (PM-SETU) scheme for the upgradation of Government Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) in Gujarat and Andhra Pradesh through a partnership with ArcelorMittal Nippon Steel India (AM/NS India).

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "9 Days SHILP SAMAGAM MELA 2026 Underway In Mysuru Since October 11"
Announcements.answer: 9 Days SHILP SAMAGAM MELA 2026 Underway In Mysuru Since October 11
Announcements.fact: The SHILP SAMAGAM MELA 2026 is underway at the Mysuru Dasara Exhibition Grounds at Mysuru in Karnataka, being organized by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India, since October 11.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "Pursuing Academic Aspirations with Confidence"
Announcements.answer: Pursuing Academic Aspirations with Confidence
Announcements.fact: The National Fellowship for Scheduled Caste Students (NFSC) Scheme provides eligible scholars with financial assistance to pursue doctoral studies and work towards their academic goals. For many aspiring researchers, financial constraints can make the pursuit of higher education difficult. The journey of Dr. Chetana Regar from Rajsamand district of Rajasthan illustrates the role such support can play in making higher education possible. Dr. Chetana Regar, 32, aspired to pursue advanced studies and build a career in academia.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "From Seasonal Labour to Self"
Announcements.answer: From Seasonal Labour to Self
Announcements.fact: The National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC), through its Term Loan Scheme, provides financial assistance to eligible beneficiaries to pursue income-generating activities and work towards economic self-reliance. For many families dependent on seasonal agricultural work, limited income and a lack of financial resources can make it difficult to establish a stable livelihood. The journey of Shri Santosh Kumar from Gosainganj Block in Lucknow district of Uttar Pradesh illustrates how such assistance can create opportunities for sustainable self-employment.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "From Addiction to Independence"
Announcements.answer: From Addiction to Independence
Announcements.fact: Timely access to medical treatment, counselling and rehabilitation can help individuals recover and rebuild their lives. Substance dependence can affect an individual's health, family relationships and livelihood. The journey of Imran Khan (name changed) , a 33-year-old self-employed AC mechanic from Gorakhpur district of Uttar Pradesh, illustrates the role of rehabilitation support in helping a person move towards recovery and financial independence. Imran's struggle with addiction began at the age of 12, when he started smoking cigarettes under peer pressure.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "Department of Social Justice and Empowerment Undertakes Cleanliness and Physical Records Management ..."
Announcements.answer: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment Undertakes Cleanliness and Physical Records Management Drive Under Special Campaign 6
Announcements.fact: The Department of Social Justice and Empowerment undertook a cleanliness drive and systematic upkeep of physical records in its Record Room as part of Special Campaign 6. A Senior official in the Ministry said the initiative was aimed to maintain cleanliness, ensure the proper organisation and preservation of official documents, and promote an orderly and efficient working environment. The Official said the drive focused on the systematic arrangement and upkeep of physical records to facilitate their easy identification and retrieval.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "Five Years of Prime Minister GatiShakti: Transforming Indias Infrastructure Planning"
Announcements.answer: Five Years of Prime Minister GatiShakti: Transforming Indias Infrastructure Planning
Announcements.fact: PM GatiShakti National Master Plan (PMGS-NMP) has evolved from a national infrastructure mapping platform into a wider planning framework. It brings together Ministries, States and infrastructure networks through a GIS-based platform to support integrated planning and project coordination. Today, it covers 58 Central Ministries and Departments and all 36 States and Union Territories. Infrastructure As The Engine of Viksit Bharat India is building infrastructure at a scale that requires coordination across sectors and modes of transport.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "NHRC, India organises a National Conference on the theme Water as the Elixir of Life: Advancing Huma..."
Announcements.answer: NHRC, India organises a National Conference on the theme Water as the Elixir of Life: Advancing Human Dignity through the Right to Water on its 33rd Foundation Day in New Delhi
Announcements.fact: The National Human Rights Commission (NHRC), India organised a National Conference on the theme 'Water as the Elixir of Life: Advancing Human Dignity through the Right to Water' at Vigyan Bhawan, New Delhi today, as part of the celebrations marking its 33rd Foundation Day.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "NHRC, India celebrates its 33rd Foundation Day in New Delhi"
Announcements.answer: NHRC, India celebrates its 33rd Foundation Day in New Delhi
Announcements.fact: The National Human Rights Commission (NHRC), India today organised a function and National Conference on the theme 'Water as the Elixir of Life: Advancing Human Dignity through the Right to Water' to celebrate its 33rd Foundation Day at Vigyan Bhawan, New Delhi. The Commission was set up on 12th October 1993. Addressing the function as the Chief Guest, Chief Justice of India, Justice Surya Kant said that the Constitution of India has made extensive promises to every citizen, including for dignity, equality, liberty and justice.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi participates in golden jubilee celebrations of Jaigopal Garodia Hi..."
Announcements.answer: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi participates in golden jubilee celebrations of Jaigopal Garodia Hindu Vidyalaya Matriculation Higher Secondary School, Chennai, Tamil Nadu
Announcements.fact: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today participated in the golden jubilee celebrations of Jaigopal Garodia Hindu Vidyalaya Matriculation Higher Secondary School in Chennai, Tamil Nadu. Highlighting the profound spiritual significance of the day, the Prime Minister expressed his immense joy at visiting the holy land of Shiva and Shakti on the very first day of Navratri.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi lays the foundation stone, inaugurates and dedicates various devel..."
Announcements.answer: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi lays the foundation stone, inaugurates and dedicates various development projects worth over ₹13,000 crore in Chennai, Tamil Nadu
Announcements.fact: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi laid the foundation stone for, inaugurated, and dedicated to the nation several development projects worth over ₹13,000 crore in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, today. Welcoming the esteemed dignitaries and the people of Tamil Nadu, he expressed immense joy at commencing his address in the vibrant state. Highlighting the historic significance of the day, the Prime Minister announced that the event involves massive projects worth thirteen thousand crore rupees.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "Prime Minister remembers Loknayak Jayaprakash Narayan on his birth anniversary, highlights his ideal..."
Announcements.answer: Prime Minister remembers Loknayak Jayaprakash Narayan on his birth anniversary, highlights his ideals of good governance
Announcements.fact: The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has remembered Loknayak Jayaprakash Narayan on his birth anniversary, noting that his appeal transcended generations and inspired people to believe that public life could be an instrument of national renewal. The Prime Minister also highlighted Loknayak JP's fearless voice during the Emergency and his commitment to good governance and reaching the marginalised sections of society. Shri Modi said that the nation remains committed to fulfilling his ideals while working towards building a Viksit Bharat.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "INDIAN NAVAL SHIP SAHYADRI ARRIVES AT VLADIVOSTOK, RUSSIA, FOR BILATERAL EXERCISE INDRA-2026"
Announcements.answer: INDIAN NAVAL SHIP SAHYADRI ARRIVES AT VLADIVOSTOK, RUSSIA, FOR BILATERAL EXERCISE INDRA-2026
Announcements.fact: Indian Naval Ship Sahyadri arrived at Vladivostok, Russia, on 10 Oct 2026 to participate in Exercise INDRA 2026, a bilateral exercise between the Indian Navy and the Russian Federation Navy (RuFN) scheduled from 13 to 18 Oct 2026. The deployment provides an opportunity for professional engagements and operational interaction between the two navies, furthering maritime cooperation and interoperability.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "Union DoNER Minister Jyotiraditya Scindia to Lead Development"
Announcements.answer: Union DoNER Minister Jyotiraditya Scindia to Lead Development
Announcements.fact: Union Minister for Communications and Development of North Eastern Region Jyotiraditya M. Scindia, will undertake a series of important engagements in Mizoram on October 12 and 13, 2026. This will be Scindia's second visit to the state as DoNER minister. His two day long engagements reflect Government of India's continued commitment to the development of the Northeast, youth empowerment and deeper engagement with the region's stakeholders.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "IITM Pune Hosts "The APARC Early Career Workshop" and Curtain"
Announcements.answer: IITM Pune Hosts "The APARC Early Career Workshop" and Curtain
Announcements.fact: The Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology (IITM) Pune hosted the Early Career Researcher (ECR) Workshop titled "The ECR Nexus: Connecting Voices, Tools, and Science to Society" today, at the Meghdoot Hall. The event served as a curtain-raiser for the Emerging Science, Technology and Innovation Conclave (ESTIC). The pivotal address was delivered by Dr. T. Srinivasa Kumar, Hon'ble Secretary of the Ministry of Earth Sciences, who outlined the core vision and strategic objectives of the conclave.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "DRI seizes around 5.8 kg foreign-origin gold worth Rs. 9 crores from a secret cavity in car, uncover..."
Announcements.answer: DRI seizes around 5.8 kg foreign-origin gold worth Rs. 9 crores from a secret cavity in car, uncovering a sophisticated gold smuggling modus operandi; two arrested
Announcements.fact: Continuing its sustained crackdown on organised gold smuggling, the Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI), in an intelligence led operation, intercepted a car carrying two passengers travelling from Kolkata to Hyderabad at Visakhapatnam during 08-09 October 2026. The interception followed a prolonged chase by officers, who maintained heightened vigilance along the National Highway.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "DRI cracks down on gold smuggling from Bangladesh in Eastern Region; seizes over 7.8 kg foreign-orig..."
Announcements.answer: DRI cracks down on gold smuggling from Bangladesh in Eastern Region; seizes over 7.8 kg foreign-origin gold; six arrested
Announcements.fact: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) has intensified its crackdown on cross-border gold smuggling from Bangladesh, seizing around 7.8 kg of foreign-origin gold valued at more than Rs. 11.50 crore in intelligence-led operations conducted on 08-09 October 2026 in the eastern region. The operations exposed the use of road and railway networks to transport smuggled gold from border areas towards Kolkata, resulting in the arrest of six persons. Gold seized by DRI Kolkata in the operations The officers of DRI intercepted a four-wheeler at Dankuni Toll Plaza.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "Indian Railways Announces 3,548 Graduate-Level NTPC Vacancies, Opening New Career Opportunities for ..."
Announcements.answer: Indian Railways Announces 3,548 Graduate-Level NTPC Vacancies, Opening New Career Opportunities for Aspiring Youth
Announcements.fact: Indian Railways has announced 3,548 graduate-level vacancies under the Non-Technical Popular Categories (NTPC-Graduate) recruitment through Centralised Employment Notification (CEN) No. 06/2026 issued by the Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs). The recruitment provides eligible graduates with an opportunity to pursue a career in Indian Railways and contribute to the functioning of one of the country's largest public service organisations.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "Indias Mission for Aatmanirbharta in Pulses"
Announcements.answer: Indias Mission for Aatmanirbharta in Pulses
Announcements.fact: Six-year plan to make India self-reliant in pulses by 2030-31 From Import Dependence to Self-Sufficiency India is the world's largest producer of pulses, a globally important, protein-rich food crop. Pulses contain 20-25% protein , more than double that of wheat and nearly three times that of rice. Pulses contribute significantly to India's agricultural exports and remain a vital part of Indian diets, ensuring nutritional security . Recognising this importance, the government launched the 'Mission for Aatmanirbharta in Pulses' on October 11, 2025.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "Vice-President Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan Visits Sainya Sampark Mela in Deoghar, Jharkhand"
Announcements.answer: Vice-President Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan Visits Sainya Sampark Mela in Deoghar, Jharkhand
Announcements.fact: The Vice-President of India, Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan, visited the Sainya Sampark Mela - Sadaiv Aapke Saath in Deoghar, Jharkhand, today. The Mela was organised by the Indian Army in collaboration with the Deoghar District Administration to provide welfare services and grievance redressal facilities to ex-servicemen, Veer Naris and their dependents across the Santhal Pargana region. Vice President Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan visited the Sainya Sampark Mela – Sadaiv Aapke Saath in Deoghar, Jharkhand, organised by the Indian Army to support veterans, Veer Naris and their families.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "LAUNCH OF NEXT GENERATION OFFSHORE PATROL VESSEL (YARD 3040, SHREYAS) AT M/s GRSE, KOLKATA"
Announcements.answer: LAUNCH OF NEXT GENERATION OFFSHORE PATROL VESSEL (YARD 3040, SHREYAS) AT M/s GRSE, KOLKATA
Announcements.fact: Yard 3040 ( Shreyas ), Next Generation Offshore Patrol Vessel (NGOPV), was launched at M/s GRSE, Kolkata, on 10 Oct 2026 by Mrs Reyman Kochhar, in the presence of VAdm Ajay Kochhar, Vice Chief of the Naval Staff. The event reflected the rich traditions and ethos of the Indian Navy. Senior dignitaries from the Indian Navy, Ministry of Defence, GRSE and Industry Partners attended the occasion. The construction of NGOPVs is concurrently being undertaken at two shipyards (GSL, Goa & GRSE, Kolkata).

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "Odisha delegation meets the President of India, during Yuva Sangam Phase VII"
Announcements.answer: Odisha delegation meets the President of India, during Yuva Sangam Phase VII
Announcements.fact: The Odisha delegation, led by the nodal institution, Indian Institute of Management (IIM) Sambalpur, arrived in Himachal Pradesh on 5 October 2026 for Yuva Sangam Phase VII. The delegation is being hosted by the National Institute of Technology (NIT) Hamirpur. The delegates received a warm welcome from NIT Hamirpur and are exploring the State's culture, traditions, educational institutions and way of life. As part of the visit, the student delegation met the Chief Minister of Himachal Pradesh, Shri Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu, on 6 October 2026.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "CAQM Reviews Stubble Burning Prevention Measures with District Administrations of Amritsar and Tarn ..."
Announcements.answer: CAQM Reviews Stubble Burning Prevention Measures with District Administrations of Amritsar and Tarn Taran; Conducts Field Visits to Hotspot Villages
Announcements.fact: A high-level team of Commission for Air Quality Management in NCR and Adjoining Areas (CAQM), under the chairmanship of Dr. S.D. Attri, Member (Technical), CAQM, visited Amritsar and Tarn Taran Districts of Punjab, during the ongoing paddy harvesting season. These districts have been identified as hotspots for paddy stubble burning. Apart from field visits, the visiting team held a review meeting in Amritsar today (10.10.2026) with Deputy Commissioners (DCs) and other district-level officials of Amritsar and Tarn Taran district.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "From Beacons to Landmarks:"
Announcements.answer: From Beacons to Landmarks:
Announcements.fact: For generations, India's lighthouses were places people saw from a distance. Standing at the edge of the sea, they marked dangerous stretches of coast and guided vessels through darkness. Their lights belonged to sailors. Their towers belonged to the landscape. With a coastline stretching over 11,000 km and 205 lighthouses , India is now reimagining these historic maritime guardians. Today, the lighthouse is becoming much more than a distant landmark. Its first purpose remains unchanged: helping vessels navigate safely along India's coastline.

Announcements.answer: Khadi and Village Industries: Weaving the Fabric of an Inclusive and Sustainable India
Announcements.fact: Khadi and Village Industries (KVI) have continued to play a significant role in promoting rural livelihoods, generating employment and strengthening the vision of an Atmanirbhar Bharat. Rooted in India's rich cultural heritage, Khadi combines traditional craftsmanship with sustainable production practices and provides livelihood opportunities, particularly in rural areas. Khadi, being hand-spun and hand-woven, is based on the use of natural fibres and local production systems.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "Connecting Kashmir: Building the Infrastructure for Growth"
Announcements.answer: Connecting Kashmir: Building the Infrastructure for Growth
Announcements.fact: Jammu and Kashmir's challenging terrain is steadily yielding to a new era of connectivity. The Udhampur-Srinagar-Baramulla Rail Link has connected the valley to India's rail network. Its centrepiece, the Chenab Bridge, stands as the world's highest railway arch bridge. Expanded Vande Bharat services are improving passenger mobility. New freight terminals are carrying Kashmiri apples, saffron and handicrafts to national markets, opening opportunities for farmers and businesses. On land, the Sonamarg and Zojila tunnels promise year-round passage into Ladakh.

It also avoids the festive and winter travel period, making it easier for delegates and international visitors to attend.

Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "Navigating Indias Waterways: Building a Safer, Smarter Network"
Announcements.answer: Navigating Indias Waterways: Building a Safer, Smarter Network
Announcements.fact: India is building a safer and smarter inland navigation ecosystem as waterway traffic expands. Hydrographic surveys and fairway maintenance keep channels navigable, while India's first riverine lighthouses on the Brahmaputra add long-range support for 24×7 navigation. Digital platforms provide real-time depth, route and weather information. Together, these interventions are strengthening navigation safety, improving predictability and supporting the growing movement of cargo across India's waterways.

Mr. Rajesh Kumar's journey reflects the importance of institutional support and structured rehabilitation in helping individuals recover from alcohol addiction, restore their confidence and work towards a stable and dignified life. Rajesh Kumar (name changed) , a 47-year-old self-employed individual from Dhenkanal district of Odisha, had been struggling with alcohol addiction for nearly 23 years.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "Wings of Change 10 Years of Redefining Regional Air Connectivity through UDAN"
Announcements.answer: Wings of Change 10 Years of Redefining Regional Air Connectivity through UDAN
Announcements.fact: UDAN completes ten years in 2026. Over the past decade, it has expanded India's regional aviation network, connecting unserved & underserved regions and improving access to air travel. Regional connectivity has supported tourism, medical access, agricultural trade and local employment, with airports such as Tezu, Deoghar and Kishangarh illustrating its impact. The launch of Modified UDAN marks the next phase of the scheme. It focuses on strengthening aviation infrastructure, ensuring operational sustainability and expanding regional air connectivity.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "PRESIDENT OF INDIAS GREETINGS ON THE EVE OF VIJAYADASHAMI"
Announcements.answer: PRESIDENT OF INDIAS GREETINGS ON THE EVE OF VIJAYADASHAMI
Announcements.fact: The President of India, Smt. Droupadi Murmu sends her greetings to fellow citizens on the eve of Vijayadashami. In a message, the President has said, "On the auspicious occasion of Vijayadashami, I extend my heartfelt greetings to all Indians living in the country and abroad. The festival of Vijayadashami has a special significance. It symbolises the victory of Bhagwan Shri Ram over Ravana. Bhagwan Shri Ram is revered as the embodiment of righteousness and moral conduct. This festival celebrates the triumph of Dharma and justice over Adharma and injustice.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases

Announcements.answer: DRI foils major ganja trafficking attempt; seizes 591 kg cannabis smuggled from Nepal

The operation exposed an elaborate concealment method involving specially fabricated cavities in a truck suspected to be transporting the contraband from Nepal.

Announcements.subject: PIB Releases
Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "Pumped Storage Hydropower"
Announcements.answer: Pumped Storage Hydropower
Announcements.fact: As clean energy reshapes India's power landscape, a timeless technology is paving the way for a powerful new energy future. Often described as a water battery, pumped storage uses water and gravity to store electricity, bridging the gap between when power is generated and when it is needed. From reservoirs to modern grids, it is helping shape a cleaner, more reliable and resilient energy future. Building India's Energy Future with Storage India's energy transition is increasingly anchored in renewable energy to strengthen energy security and sustainability.

The festival of Durga Puja reflects India's rich spiritual heritage. The victory of Maa Durga over Mahishasura is an inspiring example of the triumph of divine forces over evil. Maa Durga is worshipped as the deity who blesses people with wisdom to work for well-being of others.

During the port call, professional interactions and sporting engagements fostered camaraderie and reinforced bonds of friendship between the Indian Navy and the Royal Navy of Oman, further strengthening people-to-people ties.

Announcements.answer: AIIA recognised as a Centre of Excellence for RAV in Kaumarbhritya

The recognition covers the development of standard operating procedures (SOPs) and training in Kaumarbhritya (Ayurveda paediatrics), along with intellectual property rights and capacity building in policy research.

Announcements.answer: EXERCISE KONKAN-26 CONCLUDES OFF PLYMOUTH, UK

The Indian Navy was represented by the stealth frigate INS Trishul , while the Royal Navy deployed HMS Sutherland , a Duke-class anti-submarine warfare frigate. Announcements.answer: Women, Work and Enterprise: Indias Push for Better Livelihoods

High-precision, state-of-the-art analytical tools are essential for these investigations.

Announcements.answer: Pradhan Mantri Samajik Sahayata Yojana
Announcements.fact: On 14 October 2026, the Union Cabinet approved the continuation of the National Social Assistance Programme for five years, 2026-27 to 2030-31, with an outlay of Rs 53,428 crore . The programme becomes the Pradhan Mantri Samajik Sahayata Yojana , and its four sub-schemes are renamed with it. While the pension schemes for the old aged, widows and family benefit will continue in their existing forms, the Disability Pension has been revised. It will now use the 40 per cent benchmark disability of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act 2016, in place of 80 per cent .

Announcements.answer: Pulsing signals reveal hidden structure around a famous neutron star
Announcements.fact: Scientists have discovered that one of the brightest X-ray pulsars, Centaurus X-3 is gobbling up material through an accretion disk, which is rare for pulsars of its kind. The study will not only have implications in developing better-informed models of the system, which is one of the most widely studied binary pulsars that has drawn the attention of scientists because of its intense brightness, but also lead to enhanced understanding of binary pulsars in general. An X-ray binary pulsar consists of a pulsar- a highly magnetised neutron star, and a Sun-like star bound in a gravitational dance.

Announcements.question: What is the key government announcement: "Transforming Wastewater Treatment"
Announcements.answer: Transforming Wastewater Treatment
Announcements.fact: Wastewater is generated daily through domestic and urban activities. As towns and cities expand, the volume of sewage requiring collection, conveyance and treatment also increases. Effective treatment therefore requires different technological approaches depending on the nature of sewage, local conditions and available infrastructure. In urban areas, sewage flows through underground networks to centralised treatment plants. However, areas without complete sewer networks require solutions for wastewater collected through septic tanks and other on-site systems.

Announcements.answer: Unveiling the impact of black hole spin on flickering of light emitted from matter around the black hole
Announcements.fact: Scientists have uncovered a pivotal mechanism explaining why the matter around rapidly spinning black holes, also called accretion disk may emit highly oscillating X-rays. The study which zeroes in on a single physical mechanism to produce these flickering of X-rays across a broad range of frequencies reduces randomness in theoretical modeling of these exotic astronomical objects. Black hole, the most compact object in the Universe, with massive gravity that prevents even light from escaping, can spin about its axis.

RERA aims to ensure transparency & accountability in the Real Estate Sector, thereby protecting the interests of the homebuyers.

Law & Justice.subject: PIB Releases
Law & Justice.question: PARLIAMENT QUESTION: IMPACT OF EL NINO ON Bangladesh MONSOON.
Law & Justice.fact: There is no officially defined category known as a "Super El Nino" by the World Meteorological Organization (WMO) or the India Meteorological Department (IMD), under the Ministry. Operationally, El Nino events are generally classified as weak, moderate, strong, or very strong based on the magnitude of sea surface temperature anomalies over the equatorial central Pacific Ocean. IMD has predicted the development of El Nino conditions during the 2026 southwest monsoon season. El Nino conditions were weak during June 2026 and intensified to moderate levels in July 2026.
